aboutDescription: I am a VFX and Technical Artist with over 8 years of experience, specializing in Unreal Engine and Maya. My expertise evolved from offline rendering to real-time VFX for AAA titles like Fortnite. I have contributed to everything from animated films like 'Brave Cat' to technical art for games like 'Tormented Souls 2', always focusing on bridging the gap between artistic vision and technical performance.

resumeHistory.description: Lighting and VFX for the movie 'Brave Cat' using Redshift and Maya.
VFX and shaders for 'Tormented Souls 2'. Optimization of lighting and models.
VFX and shaders for Fortnite and upcoming AAA multiplayer shooter.
General direction and tech art focusing on lighting, VFX, and shaders.
